_comment: EXAMPLE rules only — NOT complete security coverage. Sensitive paths are highly project-specific: tune include/exclude per project. Matching is advisory: the sole consumer is scripts/resolve-review-profile.js, which folds a hit into a file's review-profile reasons (suggested tier/route); nothing here writes any state. Security semantics often live in generic paths (e.g. src/services/user.ts) that no path rule can catch — the model may and should escalate to thorough on semantics even with zero hits.
_matching: Entries are anchored path-segment sequences matched root-relative: entry 'auth' matches 'auth', 'auth/login.ts', 'src/auth/login.ts' but NOT 'author/index.ts' (segment-anchored, not substring). Multi-segment entries like 'config/secrets' match that exact segment run. Exclude wins over include; first matching rule wins.
